Delhi Cyber Cell Investigates High School Student Over 17 Lakh Life Certificate Fraud APK

31 Oct 2026, 07:37 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.inextlive.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysDelhi Cyber Cell authorities are investigating a financial fraud case involving a retired employee from Delhi who lost 17 lakh rupees after allegedly being tricked into downloading a fraudulent Android Application Package (APK) file under the guise of creating a life certificate.

Image: www.inextlive.com · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9; original source image

In this article
  1. Investigation Involves Digital Evidence and Software Analysis
  2. Key Findings and Ongoing Inquiries

Investigation Involves Digital Evidence and Software Analysis

Delhi Cyber Cell authorities are investigating a financial fraud case involving a retired employee from Delhi who lost 17 lakh rupees after allegedly being tricked into downloading a fraudulent Android Application Package (APK) file under the guise of creating a life certificate.

According to Delhi Cyber Cell Sub-Inspector Gaurav Kumar, the victim was instructed to download the file, which subsequently led to the unauthorized withdrawal of funds. Following digital investigations, law enforcement linked the creation of the file to Karan Kumar, a 12th-grade student originally from the Dhanghata area of Sant Kabir Nagar district, who was residing with his family in the Saket Nagar area of Gorakhpur's Ramgarhtal region.

Key Findings and Ongoing Inquiries

Investigators have recovered a laptop and mobile phone belonging to the student, uncovering several digital pieces of evidence.

  • Discovered Tools: Authorities reportedly found an APK file named 'ginoshell.com' and software labeled 'Digital Lutera'.
  • Timeline: Preliminary findings suggest the APK file used in the incident was created approximately six months prior to the arrest.
  • Current Actions: Delhi Police, with the assistance of local law enforcement, arrested the student and obtained a transit remand to Delhi for further questioning.

Practical Implications and Verification

This case highlights ongoing risks associated with unsolicited APK downloads and social engineering tactics targeting retirement and life certificate procedures. Consumers are advised to exercise caution when asked to download applications outside of official app stores, particularly when dealing with sensitive financial or government-related verification processes.

To verify official announcements regarding cyber crime investigations and advisories, citizens should consult official releases from local police departments or the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) portals. Independent verification of source details can be conducted by reviewing official statements issued directly by the Delhi Police Cyber Cell.
